newsitem.title: USA: The top 10 movies at the U.S. weekend box office.
newsitem.headline: The top 10 movies at the U.S. weekend box office.

text.p: Following are the studios' estimates for the top 10 movies at the box office during the Feb. 28-March 2 weekend, according to Exhibitor Relations Co.
NOTE: Last weekend's place in parenthesis.
"The Empire Strikes Back" and "Star Wars" are released by 20th Century Fox, a unit of News Corp..
"Donnie Brasco," "Booty Call," "Absolute Power" and "Fools Rush In" are released by Sony Corp..
"Dante's Peak" is released by Universal Pictures, a unit of Seagram Co. Ltd.
"Vegas Vacation" and "Rosewood" are released by Warner Bros., a unit of Time Warner Inc..
"Marvin's Room" is released by Miramax Films, a unit of Walt Disney Co..
